title: Crosshire Bridge Rotation: 14-day Rapid Re-integration Playbook
body:
Purpose: quick reference playbook to onboard a rehired or internally moved engineer/PM/IC into a new team in 14 days. Focus: minimize cognitive load, re-establish context, capture evidence of ramp, and unblock manager/product workstreams. This is intentionally compact and prescriptive — meant for manager+people partner pairs to run as a lightweight sprint.

Scope: applies to (a) returning ex-employees rehired within 12 months, (b) contractors converting to full-time, and (c) internal transfers across pods where role expectations shift significantly. Does NOT replace full 90-day onboarding but creates a high-velocity stabilization window.

Quick glossary:
- Bridge day: a half-day handoff session with outgoing role owner or previous manager.
- Evidence log: short, time-stamped notes capturing signals (code + doc + behavior).
- Greenlight: manager sign-off at day 14 that the person is on track to reach full autonomy.

Owner & critical contacts:
- People Partner: Priya Malhotra (copy on calendar invites, coach the manager)
- Hiring Manager: (fill)
- Buddy: (fill) — ideally a peer from receiving team
- Eng Ops/Access: Diego Alvarez — access tickets + infra onboarding

14-day high-level timeline (deliverables):
- Day -3 to 0 (pre-start): access checklist created, pre-read pack sent, 1:1 intro scheduled, role context doc shared, quick health-check with rehire about known blockers. TODO: run access dry-run with Eng Ops.
- Day 0 (onboarding + expectations): HR admin + payroll basics, manager welcome (15m), role charter review (30m), bridge day readout (30m), buddy intro (30m).
- Day 1–3 (stabilize): environment green (dev/test), first small ticket assigned, doc triage session, 30m feedback touch with manager every other day.
- Day 4–7 (signal building): complete first ticket, pair on one medium-impact task, write first evidence log entries, release/ship checklist (if applicable).
- Day 8–13 (autonomy ramp): owner of small feature end-to-end, present 15m demo to team, map 30/60/90 goals with manager draft, run 1st PR review calibration.
- Day 14 (review): evidence log recap, manager 14-day greenlight decision, plan adjustments, if not green -> 14-day extension plan + mitigation items.

Pre-start checklist (PRIOR to day 0):
- Account reactivation (SSO) requested (Eng Ops) — ticket JIRA-PEOPLE-342++
- Repo access verified for primary code paths
- Cloud permissions scoped to role (no overprovisioning)
- Slack + calendar invites created, on-call rotation exempt for first 14 days unless agreed
- Pre-read: role charter, key OKRs, recent roadmap notes, 2 top-priority tickets assigned
- Clear payroll/benefits reactivation confirmation (People Ops)

Onboarding day running order (template):
- 09:00 HR check-in (benefits, payroll) — 20m
- 09:30 Manager welcome + role expectations — 30m
- 10:00 Bridge day readout (with previous manager/owner) — 30m
- 10:45 Buddy intro (tour of codebase + local dev) — 45m
- 11:45 Lunch (social) — optional
- 13:00 Access walkthrough with Eng Ops — 30m
- 13:45 First ticket triage + task assignment (owner + acceptance criteria) — 45m
- 15:00 Evidence log setup + template walkthrough — 15m
- 15:30 End-of-day sync: manager + buddy — 15m

Interview / assessment rubric to use if conversion includes a technical validation (mini-blocking loop):
- Purpose: quick signal check when role expectation differs from previous tenure, or >12 months away, or critical seniority change. Use only as targeted check to validate unknown risk. Not a full re-interview.

Scoring palette (0–4):
- 0 = no exposure; 1 = limited; 2 = competent with guidance; 3 = independent; 4 = strong ownership & mentoring behavior.

Lens areas (pick 3–4 based on role):
- Problem decomposition & scoping
- Core domain/stack familiarity (e.g., LLM-inference infra: batching, KV caches)
- Code hygiene & PR quality (tests, readability)
- Cross-team communication & escalation judgment
- Security/compliance hygiene (for private deployments)

Calibration notes: use rubric anchors in a 30–45m pairing exercise or PR review. Have interviewer annotate evidence lines (one-sentence observations) into the evidence log. People partner to moderate if score <2 to avoid snap rejections.

Evidence log template (one-liner entries):
- [2026-03-02] Code: fixed flaky test in service X (PR#2345) — main risk: intermittent race on cache warmup. Signal: competent (score 2)
- [2026-03-04] Comm: triaged incident postmortem with cross-functional team — signal: strong escalation, clear owner (score 3)

Manager playbook (what manager must do):
- Day -2: set realistic 14-day outcomes and cancel non-critical recurring meetings for the rehire
- Day 0–7: 3 short check-ins: day 0 EOD, day 3, day 7. Keep them <20m and action-oriented
- Day 10: draft 30/60/90 with specifics and key tickets
- Day 14: sign greenlight or record extension w/ clear mitigation items and owners

Buddy responsibilities (first 14 days):
- Help configure local dev env, walkthrough top 3 code paths, sit in on first PR review, be available for ad-hoc questions at least 2 hours/day.
- Make micro-intros to 4 stakeholders (SRE lead, product PM, infra eng, security contact) in first 3 days.

Communication templates (short):
- Manager->Team intro (to send day 0): "Quick intro: on Day 0 we welcome [Name], rejoining to help deliver [area]. They’ll be paired with [Buddy]. Please welcome them and hold non-essential meetings for two weeks as they ramp."
- Manager->People Partner status update (day 7): "On track / Yellow / Red + 2line reason + blockers needing People Ops/Eng Ops help"

Metrics & success signals (what we measure):
- Access time-to-ready (target: <24h post Day 0)
- First meaningful commit merged (target: within 7 days)
- Evidence log count (target: 3+ scored entries by day 14)
- Manager confidence rating (1–5) at day 14 (target: >=4)

Failure modes & remediation patterns:
- No access after 48h -> escalate Eng Ops and pause any deadlines
- Low evidence signals at day 7 -> assign focused pairing + reduced meeting load
- Mismatch in expectations (manager vs rehire) -> rapid calibration meeting with people partner + rewrite role charter

Loose notes / ideas for follow-up (questions to resolve):
- Should on-call exemption be formalized in policy for the first 14 days? (ask SRE)
- How do we treat rehired ICs who previously owned deprecated systems? do we require explicit mapping to modern stack?
- Can we make a reusable Notion template for the evidence log and demo recordings?

Attachments & artifacts to update after run:
- Add postmortem to CONFC-1123 and update the role charter page
- Tag JIRA-PEOPLE-342 with outcome = green / extension / offboard

Notes to self (author): keep this playbook short — teams love checklists. Make a one-click calendar pack (Day0, D3, D7, D14) available from People Ops toolkit.

Status: draft — please add inline comments and any missing stakeholder (security, SRE) before we flip to final.
